component.name: Cadence
component.summary: Plan your day and understand your week

description.p: Cadence is a local-first desktop timetable for planning a day and understanding a week.
Create focused time blocks, keep recurring routines, and make changes with confidence while your data stays on your computer.
Adds a half-hour Week grid with correctly aligned events and a rolling seven-day window anchored on today.
Remediates the Wayland audit with deterministic tray shutdown, release-contract validation, and completed regression coverage.
Adds actionable reminders, Vim-style Week viewport navigation, and a Linux tray lifecycle for minimized Cadence windows.
Adds a continuously scrollable seven-day Week viewport and separates Themes and Typography settings with live previews.
Adapts category colours to the active theme across the calendar, filters, and settings.
Opens preferences in a dedicated Settings window and uses a more compact title toolbar.
Makes Week the main workspace and opens day plans in an interactive sheet.
Adds Cmd/Ctrl-click multi-selection and date-aware weekly recurrence.
Gives the week overview more space in the initial split-view layout.
